items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: They had, if I can remember, Manuel Perez, Peter Boccage, Andrew Kimball, Vic Gasper

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Let's see. They had, if I can remember, Manuel Perez, Peter Boccage, Andrew Kimball, Vic Gasper, Buddy or Yank Johnson? I can't remember. Was it Buddy or Yank played with it? Buddy. Buddy or Yank Johnson?
Was it Buddy Johnson played with you?
